elevFit.method: least-squares plane between detrended CTX DEM and recorded rover elevations (traverse.json), in-sample
elevFit.note: Absolute elevation = DEM + a + b*x_km_east + c*y_km_south. Slope unaffected.

slopeCheck.method: DEM slope vs along-track grade from rover-recorded elevations, 40-120 m stretches, in-sample
